answer: On a V12 retry the timeout is reset rather than carried over: when an attempt times out and attempts remain, the engine schedules a retry after the backoff, and the retry arms a new timeout event at the retry time plus the configured timeout. The deadline is per-attempt, not per-request lifetime, so each attempt receives a fresh full timeout and the fired timeout becomes stale and is ignored. A request with three attempts can therefore spend up to three timeouts plus two backoffs in the system. Omitting the reset is a documented failure mode: the retry would inherit an expired deadline and fail immediately.
